passage.label: attend you prominent beings which favors deny; company jinn mankind able pass regions heavens earth pass not pass except authority which favors deny; sent flame fire smoke not defend which favors deny; heaven split rose-colored oil which favors deny; Day none asked sin men jinn which favors deny; criminals known marks seized forelocks feet which favors deny; this Hell criminals deny which favors deny; go around between it scalding water heated utmost which favors deny

arabicExcerpts.text: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ
يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةٗ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٞ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

mainSubject.label: Divine attention announced toward the two prominent beings; the company of jinn and mankind challenged to pass beyond the regions of heavens and earth, unable to do so except by authority; flame and smoke sent against them with no self-defence possible; the heaven split open becoming rose-coloured like oil; on that Day no man or jinn questioned about sin since criminals are known by their marks and seized by forelocks and feet; Hell identified as what the criminals denied, circulating between it and scalding water heated to the utmost — each stage sealed by the favours-denial refrain

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the eighth refrain after daily disposal (30) before the thaqalan address opens (31); P2 ends with the fifteenth refrain after the Hell-hamim circulation (45); P3 covers the first garden pair through the good-for-good principle and its refrain (46-61); P4 covers the second garden pair through the closing blessing on the divine name (62-78). The 31 occurrences of the favours-denial refrain are labelled individually with their preceding subject so no subordinate label repeats.
